tools.name: scan_domain_ai_readiness
tools.description: Returns AI Visibility Score (0-100), 7-platform CMS detection, 3-pillar JSON-LD readiness (Entity, FAQPage Q&A count, Offer pricing), GPTBot/PerplexityBot/ClaudeBot WAF & robots.txt access, Shopify /api/ucp/mcp + /agents.md status, and 1 sample prompt citation preview.

tools.name: get_citation_gaps_and_fanouts
tools.description: Paid Tool (Pro/Agency): Returns 3-engine citation share, ranked citation gap domains, verified editorial outreach drafts, unblurred competitor citation URLs, and observed AI engine sub-queries (Gemini webSearchQueries, ChatGPT web_search_call, Perplexity Agent citations). Costs 1 credit cached or 10

tools.name: check_brand_hallucinations
tools.description: Paid Tool (Pro/Agency): Compares ChatGPT, Gemini, and Perplexity claims against verified pricing, shipping/delivery thresholds, and SKU exclusions. Costs 1 credit cached or 10 credits with live_refresh=true.

tools.name: generate_geo_fix_bundle
tools.description: Paid Tool (Pro/Agency): Generates ready-to-publish JSON-LD entity/FAQ schemas, /llms.txt, custom /agents.md or Shopify agents.md.liquid override, Answer-First FAQs, platform-tailored 1-click AI remediation prompt, and rival comparison pages—all syntax-validated against your Brand Truth Sheet.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_citation_gaps_and_fanouts · Public sink: get_citation_gaps_and_fanouts, generate_geo_fix_bundle.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_citation_gaps_and_fanouts · Public sink: get_citation_gaps_and_fanouts, generate_geo_fix_bundle

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "scan_domain_ai_readiness" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
